Terms.Name: Block
Terms.Description: A small area in the city or a Combine installation or outpost

Terms.Name: Canal block
Terms.Description: The part of the canals that's still within the city limits

Terms.Name: Control section
Terms.Description: Controlled area of significance

Terms.Name: Distribution block
Terms.Description: Storefront or commercial building

Terms.Name: Transit block
Terms.Description: Bus or train station area

Terms.Name: Polity
Terms.Description: City or urban center

Terms.Name: Production block
Terms.Description: Factory or warehouse area

Terms.Name: Residential block
Terms.Description: Housing area, usually consisting of multiple tenement buildings

Terms.Name: Workforce intake hub
Terms.Description: One of the only few official channels in or out of a city, often used to take in new citizens from other cities

Terms.Name: Deserviced area
Terms.Description: An area which is no longer in service by the Combine

Terms.Name: Repurposed area
Terms.Description: An area that has been refurbished to serve a different purpose than its original

Terms.Name: Condemned zone
Terms.Description: A restricted area, likely one that is no longer in use

Terms.Name: Industrial zone
Terms.Description: An industrialized zone containing pre-occupation factories

Terms.Name: Infested zone
Terms.Description: An area infested by alien presence containing parasites or Xen growth

Terms.Name: Outland zone
Terms.Description: Areas outside of Combine-controlled cities

Terms.Name: Quarantine zone
Terms.Description: Restricted area infested by abundant alien presence

Terms.Name: Terminal restriction zone
Terms.Description: No trespass under penalty of terminal prosecution

Terms.Name: 404 zone
Terms.Description: An area where a riot or active communal unrest is currently ongoing

Terms.Name: Section
Terms.Description: A large area in the city determining Civil Protection jurisdiction

Terms.Name: Sector
Terms.Description: A large region under Combine control/jurisdiction

Terms.Name: Vector
Terms.Description: The position of one point in space relative to another

Terms.Name: Zone
Terms.Description: A large purpose-oriented area, such as the industrial region of a city, a quarantine or the areas in between cities

Terms.Name: Central Transport Facility
Terms.Description: A depot housing prisoners and/or stalkers

Terms.Name: Citadel
Terms.Description: A Combine megastructure that houses a bulk of the Combine's assets

Terms.Name: Hardpoint
Terms.Description: An outlying structure or defensive position outside of a fortification

Terms.Name: Nexus
Terms.Description: A command center for the Combine Overwatch's forces in a given region

Terms.Name: High priority region
Terms.Description: An area with significant importance to the Combine

Terms.Name: Non-patrol region
Terms.Description: An area in which no effort is put into controlling
